sourceDescription:
À VENDRE : Appartement situé à Reims, ce bien immobilier de type appartement offre une superficie de 66 mètres carrés, idéal pour un couple ou une petite famille.

L'appartement se trouve dans une résidence récente, garantissant des normes de construction modernes et un cadre de vie agréable. Bien que non meublé, cet espace offre une toile vierge pour que vous puissiez y apporter votre touche personnelle et créer un intérieur qui vous ressemble.

L'un des atouts majeurs de cet appartement est son balcon, qui vous permettra de profiter de l'extérieur tout en restant chez vous. C'est un espace parfait pour se détendre, prendre un café le matin ou simplement admirer la vue. De plus, la proximité de la gare et du centre-ville de Reims est un véritable atout pour ceux qui recherchent un accès facile aux transports en commun et aux commodités urbaines.

L'appartement dispose d'un ascenseur, ce qui peut être un point à considérer pour ceux qui privilégient l'accessibilité. En revanche, il est important de noter qu'une place de parking est incluse, ce qui est un avantage considérable dans une ville où le stationnement peut parfois être un défi.

En résumé, cet appartement à Reims combine confort, modernité et praticité, tout en étant idéalement situé pour profiter de la vie urbaine. N'hésitez pas à envisager ce bien pour votre futur projet immobilier.
Le bien dispose d'un garage box fermé.

Les informations sur les risques auxquels ce bien est exposé sont disponibles sur le site Géorisques : www.georisques.gouv.fr
notes: Citya Champagne live source ref TAPP972057, freshly fetched, read in full, and reviewed on 2026-10-08. This is an active conventional whole-apartment resale at the complete EUR 194,000 seller-fee-inclusive purchase price, below the EUR 400,000 cap; the source also explicitly says the property is not under compromis. All 12 available original Citya gallery files were downloaded and individually visually inspected at original-source resolution. Images 1 through 4 show coherent complementary views of the same empty living room, its two ground-floor glazed openings and wall-mounted radiator; images 5 and 6 show complementary empty bedroom views with matching flooring, patio or balcony access and a wall-mounted radiator; images 7 and 8 show the same fitted galley kitchen from complementary angles; image 9 shows the actual bathroom with bath and screen; image 10 shows built-in hallway storage; image 11 shows the internal hall and adjoining rooms; image 12 shows the modern four-level residential façade. No photo is labelled virtual staging or AI-generated, and no staged furnishing was introduced. The repeated room views, finishes, openings and façade are internally coherent and show no tenancy document, house, boat, commercial premises, ancillary-only asset, stock-image substitution, bot signal or impossible room-to-surface combination. The garage box and separately worded included parking place are source-description facts but are not shown in the gallery, so they remain text-supported rather than visually confirmed. The structured source calls the heating 'individuel fuel radiateur', while the visible wall units in the kitchen and bedrooms look like electric convectors; the source wording is preserved, but this unresolved heating-type disagreement is not treated as visually verified. The page exposes RDC in a four-storey/four-level building, lift, equipped kitchen, one bathroom, individual hot water and very good condition. The copropriété contains 65 lots with EUR 960 annual current charges. DPE D at 230 kWhEP/m²/year and GES B at 7 kg CO2/m²/year are source-exposed, with EUR 1,322 to EUR 1,788 estimated annual energy cost. The source links to Géorisques but states no property-specific risk finding. No property tax, named individual agent, construction year or source-labelled publication/update date is exposed, so none is inferred; the review time is retained only as observedAt. Full-description review found no tenant, current lease, occupied sale, delayed vacancy, viager, bare ownership, timeshare, fractional ownership, auction, starting price, managed or commercial lease, houseboat or misleading partial-price wording. Exact-source-ID and first-photo scans across current reviewed evidence found no TAPP972057 or matching gallery URL. Current active-database near-unit review found four materially different Reims three-room records between 61 and 71 m² and EUR 170,000 to EUR 215,000: a 66 m² first-floor 1923 Guy Hoquet unit at EUR 172,800 with terrace/cellar/attic and DPE F; a 68.2 m² third-floor 1970 Century 21 unit at EUR 184,000 with lift, DPE E and EUR 2,470.80 annual charges; a 70 m² third/top-floor 1960 Guy Hoquet unit at EUR 189,900 with garage/cellar; and a 66 m² third-floor 1970 Guy Hoquet unit at EUR 195,000 with collective gas, balcony/cellar and EUR 3,000 annual charges. Their floors, age, energy, charges, features and photos differ materially from this RDC recent-residence Citya unit, so no same physical unit was found.
